release_notes: Hotfix + editor usability release. CRITICAL Landings fix: the 1.1.9 table rewrite passed the column OBJECT into the cell renderer, so ID/Status/Name/Group/Type/URL/Last Event all rendered as '-' and every metric sat one column left of its header — rows now render every fixed column and the checkbox cell is back, header and body counts match. Column drag-and-drop in Campaigns/Offers never started: the grip lived inside the sort <button> (a native drag cannot begin on an interactive descendant), the header component was re-created on every render so the dragover highlight remounted the <th> mid-drag, and the drag payload was never set (Firefox refused to start at all) — the grip is now its own drag source, the header lives at module scope, and dataTransfer carries the index; CampaignReports gets the Firefox payload fix too. Navbar dropdowns (gear + user menu) rendered behind report overlays: the navbar layer is raised above page-level overlays while true modals and the mobile drawer keep their order. Both parameter buttons are now driven by the campaign's traffic source (traffic_sources.parameters_json — the same {alias, param, macro} contract the click path uses): 'Facebook Parameters' emits param={{macro}} per source row in the source's order (generic Facebook defaults until a source is picked, with a hint), 'Add All Tracking Parameters' emits param={alias} plus the tracker-native macros — and merges into the existing Direct URL query instead of wiping hand-typed parameters (user values win on collisions, no key is emitted twice, re-clicking is a no-op). Stream Offers/Landings lists get a 'Split Evenly' button (enabled items only, paused rows keep their weight, rounding remainder on the first enabled item — the exact set the router rotates) and the static '%' next to weights becomes a live share badge (weight / enabled-total, one decimal, '-' while paused). AFTER UPDATING, HARD-RELOAD THE PANEL ONCE (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R) — index.js has a stable filename and browsers cache the old build.
